selection.selection_rule: Hard source, accessibility, duration, freshness and permanent-dedup gates precede weighted ranking.
selection.topic_diversity: Candidate pool spans design thinking, archival history/genomics, entomology, cultural psychology, demography, architecture, spaceflight, ancient religion and arts/health. The selected human-behavior and decision-design topic is distinct from the prior seven days' plant acoustics, user-interface history, accelerators, nutrition labels, wartime black markets, cultural exchange documentary and mystery TV.

observed_fields: 51-minute duration on Apple Podcasts distribution page
scope_limitations: The full 51-minute audio was not played end to end in this runtime.
The official page states that the transcript may be from an earlier version and may differ from the audio.
The episode's behavioral framework was treated as a viewpoint for English study, not as clinical advice or a universally proven life formula.

preflight.concurrent_head_changes: Journal publication advanced main during preparation; fresh trees, history baseline and all newly added PREPARED evidence were re-read before the English PREPARED record was created.
